Method.Implementation:
s $zt="errorsave" s Msg="",Status="0" //定义初始值 s StramStatus="" ts set TCIndent=$ZConvert(TCIndentity,"U")
s rowid="" s rowid=$o(^NurMp.TemplateI("TCIndentity"," "_TCIndent,rowid),-1)
if rowid="" set b=##class(NurMp.Template).%New() else set b=##class(NurMp.Template).%OpenId(rowid) s b.Indentity=Indentity s b.TCIndentity=TCIndentity s b.HospitalID=HospitalID s Stream=##class(%FileBinaryStream).%New() s Stream.Filename=argFile s StramStatus = b.Content.CopyFrom(Stream)
i ($$$ISERR(StramStatus)) tro q ##class(NurMp.ErrorMsg).ReturnMsgJson("流数据保存失败","-1") else d b.%Save()
s Stream="" s json=##class(%ArrayOfDataTypes).%New() d json.SetAt($g(Msg),"msg")
d json.SetAt($g(Status),"status") d json.SetAt(b.%Id(),"data") tc q ##class(NurMp.ErrorMsg).Encode(json) errorsave s Msg=$ze q ##class(NurMp.ErrorMsg).ReturnMsgJson(Msg,"-1")

Method.name: BackUp
Method.Implementation:
s $zt="errorBackUp" s version = ##class(NurMp.Config).GetVersion() s fullFilePath = filepath_version_"\InterFace\"
if (##class(%File).DirectoryExists(fullFilePath) = 0) { d ##class(%File).CreateDirectoryChain(fullFilePath) }
s fullFilePath = fullFilePath_TCIndentity_".xml"
s TCIndent=$ZConvert(TCIndentity,"U") s id="" s id=$o(^NurMp.TemplateI("TCIndentity"," "_TCIndent,id),-1)
s textxml=##class(NurMp.Template).%OpenId(id) s fileStream = textxml.Content
s file = ##class(%FileBinaryStream).%New() s file.Filename = fullFilePath
Do fileStream.Rewind() While('fileStream.AtEnd){ s bytes = fileStream.Read(1024) Do file.Write(bytes) } Do file.Flush() s sc= file.%Save() s file = "" If $$$ISERR(sc) { Do $System.Status.DisplayError(sc) Quit -1 } q 0 errorBackUp q -1

Method.name: Lock
Method.Implementation:
s $zt="errorLock" s Msg="",Status="0" //定义初始值 s ^TMPNW(88)=$lb(indentity, ip, hander) s code=$zcvt(indentity,"U") s id="" set id=$o(^NurMp.TemplateCategoryI("Indentity"," "_code,id)) if ($listget(^NurMp.TemplateCategoryD(id),8) = "true") { s Status = "1" s Msg = "当前模板已经被删除" } elseif $d(^NurMP.NurEmrSubLock("Mp",code)) || $d(^NurMP.NurEmrSubDeleteLock("Mp",code)) { s Status = "1" s Msg = "当前模板正在被别的客户端使用,"_^NurMP.NurEmrSubLock("Mp",code) } else { s nowtime=$h
s ^NurMP.NurEmrSubLock("Mp",code)=ip_"^"_hander_"^"_nowtime_"^"_nowtime } s json=##class(%ArrayOfDataTypes).%New() d json.SetAt($g(Msg),"msg") d json.SetAt($g(Status),"status") d json.SetAt("","data") q ##class(NurMp.ErrorMsg).Encode(json) errorLock s Msg=$ze q ##class(NurMp.ErrorMsg).ReturnMsgJson(Msg,"-1")

Method.name: UnLock
Method.Implementation: s code=$zcvt(indentity,"U") q:code="" -99 i $d(^NurMP.NurEmrSubLock("Mp",code)) { k ^NurMP.NurEmrSubLock("Mp",code) } q 0
